messages:
alex: Heads-up: found a repeatable bundling break for the JS SDK when targeting edge runtimes (Vercel Edge / Cloudflare) with webpack/rollup/vite. Repro steps below.
maria: Oof, what error?
alex: Runtime errors like `ReferenceError: process is not defined` or build warnings about `fs` missing. Works fine in node.
alex: Repro steps I used: 1) consumer project has "type": "module" 2) import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js' 3) bundle with webpack5 / rollup / vite 4) deploy to an edge function.
ken: Logs?
alex: Build shows: 
WARNING in ./node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.js
Module not found: Error: Can't resolve 'fs'
Then runtime: ReferenceError: process is not defined (edge).
sam: Likely bundler is pulling CJS or node-only code path. How are package entries defined?
alex: SDK package.json has main -> dist/index.cjs.js, module -> dist/index.esm.js, and an exports map, but some bundlers still pick the CJS entry.
eva: Workarounds that helped me: webpack: set resolve.mainFields = ['browser','module','main'] and ProvidePlugin to polyfill process; rollup: node-resolve plugin with mainFields ['module','main']; vite: optimizeDeps.include ['@redwood/inference-js'] and define process.env.NODE_ENV.
maria: Any short-term customer guidance?
alex: Recommend: prefer ESM consumer builds, avoid reading process.env at module top-level (read inside functions), and configure bundler mainFields to prefer module/browser.
sam: SDK action items: audit top-level requires of node builtins (fs, path), guard them with `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` or use dynamic imports. Add explicit exports mapping import->esm, require->cjs to guide bundlers.
eva: TS note: consumers should set moduleResolution: 'node16' for ESM packages; we might need typesVersions for compatibility.
ken: Can someone make a tiny repro repo?
ci-bot: Repo created at internal/devex/sdk-edge-bundle. CI shows failing bundle-edge-test.
alex: I'll push minimal examples (webpack, rollup, vite) and an edge handler that imports createClient. Will link when done.
maria: Thanks — I'll try Vercel + Cloudflare once repo is up.
sam: Saving this thread as the triage/repro tracker. :thumbsup:
